title: Venue disagreement
description: How far Coinbase and Kraken are from each other on BTC. The two rarely quote the same midpoint, and the one that moves first usually leads.

dispersion_bps.label: Venue gap
dispersion_bps.description: The gap between the two venues' midpoints as a share of price, in basis points. A wide gap means one venue is repricing ahead of the other.

leading_venue.label: Leading venue
leading_venue.description: Which venue moved first on the latest move. The other is expected to follow.
